ns2:course.label: Leading School Improvement
ns2:course.description: Study of major ideas on school improvement, past and present, and of emerging research on the condition of public education in the United States. In-depth examination of reform proposals for changing the organization of schools, the instructional program, and the roles of students, teachers, and school administrators. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in the College of Education or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate standing in the College of Education or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
